The system is built on the same fishing logic used in the Angler Adventures mobile game, where players learn how bass behavior changes based on environment and conditions. This companion app applies that same decision engine to real-world fishing, using the same environmental logic and original artwork from the game.

Instead of endless gear lists or vague advice, you get ranked recommendations and clear guidance on how to fish each lure.

payload.name: Autovit.ro

用日常语言在罗马尼亚寻找你的理想汽车。跳过复杂的筛选器和搜索表单。通过 Autovit，只需描述你的需求——“低里程 SUV，适合 4 人家庭”或“新款城市用车”。

payload.name: Burger King

With the official BURGER KING® app, explore our menu and find your nearest BK® restaurant anytime, anywhere. And in most locations, you can even order ahead.

payload.name: atHome

atHome.lu, Luxembourg’s leading real estate platform, now integrates directly into your ChatGPT experience.

Search for apartments, houses, and investment opportunities using natural language — just describe what you’re looking for. Browse listings with photos, pricing, and key details directly in the chat, displayed in a smooth carousel format.

卢森堡领先的房地产平台 atHome.lu 现已直接融入你的 ChatGPT 体验。

使用自然语言搜索公寓、住宅和投资机会——只需描述你要找的房产。直接在聊天中浏览包含照片、价格和关键详情的房源，以流畅的轮播形式展示。

payload.name: foodora

foodora lets users discover nearby food delivery restaurants, search for vendors and dishes, and browse full menus with prices, ratings, delivery estimates, and active promotions. Each result includes deep links so the user can continue to order in the foodora app or website. Results render in interactive vendor and menu card widgets.

payload.name: Digimarket
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Digimarket helps verified businesses find and list excess industrial inventory. Search by OEM part number, brand, category, quantity, unit, and price for cable, terminal blocks, ferrules, connectors, breakers, contactors, sensors, and related materials. Sellers prepare Excel-based listings in Talos; buyers discover available stock and contact sellers. Business verification is required for marketplace actions.

payload.name: Le Parisien

Accédez aux informations du Parisien : retrouvez les dernières actualités, recherchez des articles et suivez nos directs des grands événements facilement depuis ChatGPT.

Une façon simple et rapide de rester informé de l’actualité avec Le Parisien

payload.name: Rentals.ca Rental Search
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Search Canadian rental listings by city or nearby landmark and view matching apartments, homes, prices, photos, and locations in ChatGPT. Users can search by city, apply common filters such as rent, beds, baths, parking, pets, furnished status, lease terms, availability, and verified listings, or search near a landmark, university, building, or station. Results include concise listing summaries for ChatGPT and an interactive widget with listing cards, a map, pagination, and links back to Rentals.ca listing pages.

payload.name: Access Yami
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Access Yami helps users shop the largest Asian grocery & lifestyle store in North America directly inside ChatGPT. Users can take a Brand Taste Identity (BTI) quiz to discover their snack persona and get personalized picks, search and browse 10,000+ products by keyword, category, or brand, see trending best-sellers, link their Yami account, add items to their real Yami cart, and get a checkout link to complete purchase on yami.com.

payload.name: CellFusion C
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: CellFusion C helps users find CellFusionC skincare products that match their skin type, concerns, preferred texture, use case, and requested category. It searches the Cafe24 product catalog, ranks suitable products, and displays recommendation cards with product images, prices, purchase links, and concise guidance.

payload.name: Bites
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Bites is an AI-native ordering platform that lets people discover restaurants, browse full menus, and place direct orders from local restaurants — all from ChatGPT, without switching to a delivery app.

Customers get the convenience of AI-powered ordering while seeing in-store menu pricing, with no markups or hidden fees. They can search by cuisine or location, ask for recommendations, customize meals, and build group orders in natural language.

Examples:

"Order from Popeyes in San Jose."
"Order 2 Not So Fried Chicken sandwiches from Mendocino Farms, no sauce, with gluten-free bread."
"Build a vegetarian-friendly office lunch order for 10 people from Boltiful Santa Clara under $20 per person. Add few desserts for the team to share."
"Show me the menu for Curry Up Now and help me pick something spicy."

For restaurants, Bites enables direct, AI-powered ordering with no commissions, no markups, and full ownership of customer relationships. Restaurants can reduce reliance on third-party delivery apps while preserving margins and serving customers through the channels they already use.

In short, Bites combines the convenience of delivery apps with the economics of ordering directly from restaurants.
payload.longDescription:
Bites 是一个 AI 原生点餐平台，让人们直接在 ChatGPT 中发现餐厅、浏览完整菜单，并向本地餐厅直接下单，无需切换到外卖应用。

顾客可以享受 AI 点餐的便利，同时看到店内菜单价格，没有加价或隐藏费用。他们可以按菜系或位置搜索、寻求推荐、定制餐点，并用自然语言组合多人订单。

示例：

“从 San Jose 的 Popeyes 点餐。”
“从 Mendocino Farms 点 2 份 Not So Fried Chicken 三明治，不要酱汁，使用无麸质面包。”
“从 Boltiful Santa Clara 为 10 人组合一份适合素食者的办公室午餐订单，每人低于 $20。添加几份甜点供团队分享。”
“给我看看 Curry Up Now 的菜单，帮我挑点辣的。”

对餐厅而言，Bites 支持 AI 驱动的直接点餐，不收佣金、不加价，餐厅完整掌握客户关系。餐厅可以减少对第三方外卖应用的依赖，同时保住利润，并通过顾客已经使用的渠道为他们服务。

简而言之，Bites 将外卖应用的便利与直接向餐厅点餐的经济优势相结合。

payload.name: LFmall

payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
복잡한 검색 대신 대화로 쇼핑하세요. LFmall은 당신의 스타일과 상황(TPO)을 이해하여 가장 '나다운' 패션과 라이프스타일 아이템을 찾아드립니다.

단순한 구매를 넘어 당신의 취향을 깊이 있게 완성해 드립니다.

payload.name: Pararius
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: With Pararius, everyone can easily find the right home. Open the site or app and search the Netherlands' largest private-sector housing offering in just a few seconds. Type a city, neighbourhood or postcode to discover properties, use filters to refine listings by price, surface area, number of rooms or furnishing, set alerts to be the first to know about new homes and contact the agent directly. An intuitive platform to use, even without experience in the Dutch rental market. Search for the home that fits you, from studios and apartments in Amsterdam to family houses in Apeldoorn.
payload.longDescription: 借助 Pararius，每个人都能轻松找到合适的家。打开网站或应用，只需几秒即可搜索荷兰最大的私人住房市场。输入城市、街区或邮政编码发现房源，按价格、面积、房间数量或家具配置筛选，设置提醒以第一时间获知新房，并直接联系中介。即使没有荷兰租赁市场经验，也能直观使用。从阿姆斯特丹的单间和公寓到阿珀尔多伦的家庭住宅，找到适合你的家。

payload.name: DEWA
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
DEWA (Dubai Electricity & Water Authority) App in ChatGPT makes it easy to check your outstanding amount and pay instantly using EasyPay, explore DEWA services, find nearby EV Green Charger locations with availability, and locate DEWA Customer Happiness Centers. Connect to DEWA through ChatGPT for quick, seamless access to the information and services you need, anytime.

تطبيق هيئة كهرباء ومياه دبي على ChatGPT يسهّل عليك التحقق من المبالغ المستحقة وسدادها فورًا من خلال خدمة الدفع السهل، والاطلاع على خدمات الهيئة، وتحديد مواقع شواحن المركبات الكهربائية القريبة وتوافرها، بالإضافة إلى تحديد مواقع مراكز إسعاد المتعاملين التابعة للهيئة. اربط الآن مع هيئة كهرباء ومياه دبي عبر ChatGPT للوصول السريع والسلس إلى المعلومات والخدمات التي تحتاجها في أي وقت.

payload.name: CarsGuide
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Search for cars currently listed for sale across Australia and read expert reviews to help you decide. Browse thousands of new and used car listings by make, model, location, price range, and more — or just describe what you're looking for in plain language. Each result includes price, odometer, photos, and a direct link to the full listing. You can also find editorial reviews with expert ratings to compare models before you buy.

payload.name: UltraFit360
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: UltraFit360 connects ChatGPT to your personal fitness and nutrition data. Ask what you ate this week, how your weight is trending, what workouts you logged, or for a full progress report — answers come straight from your UltraFit360 food diary, workout logs, body metrics, and AI coaching memory. With your confirmation, it can also log the meals you eat, adjust your daily calorie, macro, water and step targets, plan meals, swap exercises, and assign or build workout programs. UltraFit360 is operated by Aptix Labs Private Limited; see https://ultrafit360.com/privacy-policy for how connector data is handled.

payload.name: Historial de Vehiculos España

Datos de fuentes oficiales. payload.name: GrailPeople Shopping
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Search 7,000+ skincare, makeup, and hair products by ingredient, concern, or skin type, and get shopping recommendations. payload.name: Able.Style
payload.description: 适应各种天气的穿搭灵感
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Able.Style is a personal fashion and style assistant that helps you decide what to wear using clothes from your own closet, the occasion, and local weather conditions.

Ask questions like “What should I wear today?”, “What should I wear for a casual work day?” or “What outfit works for cold and rainy weather?” Get complete outfit ideas with specific clothing items and visual fashion inspiration for work, weekends, events, hot weather, cold weather, rain, and changing forecasts.

Weather-aware outfit recommendations use the location saved in your Able.Style account when you’re signed in, or the location you share with ChatGPT. You can also choose your preferred temperature and wind speed units.

When you sign in, you can add clothes you own to your closet and like or dislike outfits to refine future style suggestions. Able.Style personalizes fashion recommendations based on your wardrobe and past preferences.

It’s a simple way to save time, avoid outfit guesswork, develop your personal style, and make better use of the clothes you already have.
payload.longDescription:
Able.Style 是个人时尚与穿搭助手，根据你的衣橱、场合和当地天气情况，帮助你决定穿什么。

可以询问“今天该穿什么？”、“休闲工作日该穿什么？”或“寒冷多雨的天气适合什么搭配？”。获取包含具体单品的完整穿搭建议和视觉时尚灵感，适用于工作、周末、活动、炎热、寒冷、下雨以及变化中的天气预报。

结合天气的穿搭建议会在你登录时使用 Able.Style 账号中保存的位置，或使用你向 ChatGPT 提供的位置。你还可以选择偏好的温度和风速单位。

登录后，你可以将已有衣物添加到衣橱，并对搭配点赞或点踩，优化未来的穿搭建议。Able.Style 根据你的衣橱和以往偏好提供个性化时尚推荐。

这是一种简单的方法，帮你节省时间、避免猜测搭配、发展个人风格，并更充分地利用已有衣物。

payload.name: Wild Calf Coffee
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Tell Wild Calf Coffee how you brew and what you enjoy. It matches you to current coffees using catalog details and Wild Calf tasting and brewing information, explains why each suggestion fits, and says when a lot-specific detail has not been verified. It can troubleshoot weak, bitter, sour, or inconsistent coffee before recommending a purchase. When you are ready, it prepares a one-time Shopify cart. You review price, shipping, tax, and payment in Shopify; the plugin does not place or charge an order in ChatGPT.

payload.name: Pearl Auto
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
People often have questions about their vehicle's symptoms, repair needs, or maintenance schedules but don't have immediate access to a qualified mechanic or automotive expert.

Pearl Auto has licensed automotive technicians and mechanics review AI answers. Each AI answer is clearly marked by the expert as correct or incorrect so users can quickly understand whether the information can be trusted.

Automotive specialists across multiple areas review responses, including general automotive repair, diesel trucks, transmission & drivetrain, brakes & suspension, electrical systems, engine diagnostics, HVAC & climate control, and body & paint.

This app is designed for informational guidance only and does not replace professional automotive service.

Users can:
- Ask AI questions about vehicle symptoms, repair procedures, and maintenance
- See whether a certified mechanic marked the AI response as correct or incorrect
- Get reassurance in the moment when an in-person mechanic is unavailable

payload.name: Rakhys

payload.name: Klinger-Vogt Immobilien

Anvaya is your all inclusive wedding planning platform, brought into ChatGPT. Manage your weddings guest list and RSVPs, track your budget against real spend, compare vendor quotes, and see what's next on your to-do list.

Ask "how's our wedding going?" for an overview, "who hasn't replied to the reception yet?" to spot per-event gaps, or "compare my photographers" to put quotes side by side. Each answer renders an interactive widget tied to your actual wedding data not a static summary. Actions that change things, like sending RSVP reminders or updating a budget line, go through a quick confirmation step so nothing happens by accident.

Anvaya is purpose-built for multi-day weddings, including South Asian celebrations across: Mehndi, Haldi, Sangeet, Ceremony, Receptions, and more. Anvaya works great for single-day weddings too. Couples, parents, and the wedding party can plan together from one shared workspace at https://anvaya.love.
payload.longDescription:
Anvaya 是全面的婚礼规划平台，现已融入 ChatGPT。管理婚礼宾客名单和出席回复，对照实际支出跟踪预算，比较供应商报价，并查看待办事项中的下一步。

问“我们的婚礼筹备得怎么样？”获取概览，问“还有谁没回复是否参加婚宴？”找出各场活动中尚未回复的宾客，或问“比较我的摄影师”并排查看报价。每个回答都会呈现与真实婚礼数据关联的交互式小组件，而非静态摘要。发送出席回复提醒、更新预算条目等会改变内容的操作，均经过简短确认步骤，避免意外发生。

Anvaya 专为多日婚礼打造，包括南亚庆典中的 Mehndi、Haldi、Sangeet、婚礼仪式、婚宴等。Anvaya 也非常适合单日婚礼。新人、父母和婚礼亲友团可在 https://anvaya.love 的同一共享工作区共同规划。

payload.name: Powerly

payload.name: Casepoint
payload.description: 电子取证、法律保全和 FOIA
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Casepoint connects your legal and investigative data to ChatGPT. Ask questions about active matters across eDiscovery, Legal Hold, and FOIA, and get clear answers drawn directly from your Casepoint workspace or organization. Check review status, hold status and rosters, and FOIA deadlines without opening the platform. Access is read-only and scoped to what you select when you connect.
payload.longDescription: Casepoint 将您的法律和调查数据连接到 ChatGPT。询问电子取证、法律保全和 FOIA 中正在处理的案件，获取直接来自 Casepoint 工作区或组织的清晰答案。无需打开平台即可查看审查状态、保全状态、人员名单和 FOIA 截止日期。访问为只读，并限定于连接时选择的范围。

payload.name: Product Link Expander
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Product Link Expander helps users inspect supported retail product links before sharing or using them. It expands short links into the final destination URL, canonical product URL, item ID, redirect count, redirect chain, warnings, and available page metadata. The app is read-only, does not require authentication, and does not store request history.

payload.name: 1800Flowers

Users can browse curated collections, search products by occasion, view detailed product information, and place orders directly on 1800flowers.com. The app provides a convenient, conversational way to explore gifting options and find the right product quickly.

payload.name: Updater Internet Store
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Finding and comparing internet and TV plans for a specific address can be time-consuming. Updater Internet Store shows which plans are available at your address and lets you compare options side-by-side on speed, price, and terms.

When you pick a plan, you’ll be directed outside of ChatGPT to complete your order online, or submit your contact information so your chosen provider’s representative can contact you to complete your order.
